units.marketingTitle: Two Bedrooms Apart, Two Full Baths, One Smart Layout
units.description: Separation is the standout feature of this 13th-floor two-bedroom at Exhibit on Superior. The split-bedroom design places the bedrooms apart, two full bathrooms support smoother routines, and a private balcony adds outdoor space to the River North layout. The entry foyer opens to a connected living and dining area with room for meals, working from home, and entertaining. The residence includes an in-unit washer and dryer, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, contemporary cabinetry, and plank flooring. Exhibit’s fifth-floor amenities include an outdoor lap pool, hot tub, sauna, grilling areas, and private work rooms. The first floor offers a dog spa and outdoor dog run. Located at Superior and Wells, the community is near CTA service and the Chicago Riverwalk. The required $150 monthly Utility and Service Amenity Fee covers heat, air conditioning, water, and natural gas for cooking and the clothes dryer. One-time fees: $500 administrative per apartment and $60 application per applicant. Electricity, cable, and internet are paid separately. Schedule your tour of apartment 1301 today to experience the split-bedroom design, two full bathrooms, private balcony, and Exhibit amenities in person.
